entities.summary: Jacques-Alain Miller is a psychoanalyst and writer. He is one of the founding members of the École de la Cause freudienne and the World Association of Psychoanalysis which he presided from 1992 to 2002. He is the sole editor of the books of The Seminar of Jacques Lacan.
